headline: Public hearings on a cannabis retailer rule change, a mixed-use zoning district, and a gas station at 124 Church St.
summary: Hearings cover a proposed cannabis retailer use in industrial zones and a new mixed-use zoning district. The gas station at 124 Church St. and the Times Microwave site plan were moved to December 14, 2026.
items: Public hearing on text amendment #507-26 from Quinnipiac Valley Growth Partners to allow cannabis retailers by special permit in the I-40 (Industrial) zone; changes Sections 4.8.C and 6.34
Public hearing on text amendment #505-26 from KSCGH Partners, LLC to add a new Section 4.27, Mixed Use (MU) District floating zone

Public hearing on special permit #407-26 from Atlantis Management Group to demolish a building and build a gas station with a 4,500± sq. ft. drive-through retail and convenience store at 124 Church St.; continued to 12/14/2026
Site plan for Times Microwave Systems at 358 Hall Avenue, #224-26; continued to 12/14/2026
Discussion on violations at Center Street Cemetery
location: Robert F. Parisi Council Chambers, Town Hall, 45 South Main Street
